{
  "method": "To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd), where E is the market value of equity, D is the market value of debt, V is the total market value of the firm (E + D), Re is the cost of equity, and Rd is the cost of debt. When the company becomes a taxpayer, the formula adjusts to WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd * (1 - T)), where T is the marginal tax rate.",
   "calculations": [
      {"label": "Total market value of the firm (V) when tax exempt", "expression": "(25 + 20)"},
      {"label": "Weight of equity in capital structure (E/V)", "expression": "(20 / (25 + 20))"},
      {"label": "Weight of debt in capital structure (D/V)", "expression": "(25 / (25 + 20))"},
      {"label": "WACC when tax exempt", "expression": "((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * 0.1)"},
      {"label": "Weight of equity in capital structure when taxpayer (E/V)", "expression": "(20 / (25 + 20))"},
      {"label": "Weight of debt in capital structure when taxpayer (D/V)", "expression": "(25 / (25 + 20))"},
      {"label": "Cost of debt after tax", "expression": "(0.1 * (1 - 0.3))"},
      {"label": "WACC when taxpayer", "expression": "((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * (0.1 * (1 - 0.3)))"}
   ],
   "keyPoints": [
      "Identification of the correct WACC formula for both tax-exempt and taxpayer scenarios",
      "Correct calculation of weights for equity and debt in the capital structure",
      "Application of the tax rate to the cost of debt in the taxpayer scenario",
      "Separate calculation of WACC for both the tax-exempt and taxpayer statuses"
   ]
}

parsedContent.method: To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd), where E is the market value of equity, D is the market value of debt, V is the total market value of the firm (E + D), Re is the cost of equity, and Rd is the cost of debt. When the company becomes a taxpayer, the formula adjusts to WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd * (1 - T)), where T is the marginal tax rate.
